about: [O8 critic] a man knocked down by my fists in the city (real LMB), looked at where he lies, walked over; a second shot dead (the wheel, LMB): does the fall read, does the body read on the wet street, is it solid to things and not to feet, does it pop?

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.people, y = G.controller.yaw; P.dbgClear(); const x = G.eye.x - Math.sin(y) * 1.5, z = G.eye.z - Math.cos(y) * 1.5; window.__a = P.dbgWalker(x, z, y); window.__a.until = 1e9; window.__a.mode = 'stand'; window.__a.stop && window.__a.stop(); return JSON.stringify({ eye: [G.eye.x, G.eye.z, y], a: [x, z, window.__a.kind] }); })()
JSON.stringify({ mode: window.__a.mode, down: !!window.__a.down, hits: window.__a.hits, rag: !!window.__a.fig.rag, brawl: !!(G.brawl && G.brawl.active), crowd: !!(G.crowd && G.crowd.active) })

(() => { const p = window.__a, R = p.fig.rag; return JSON.stringify({ mode: p.mode, down: !!p.down, asleep: R ? R.asleep : null, minY: R ? +Math.min(...R.p.map(q => q.y)).toFixed(3) : null, ground: +G.stage.surfaceY(p.pos.x, p.pos.z).toFixed(3), at: [+p.pos.x.toFixed(2), +p.pos.z.toFixed(2)] }); })()

(() => { const P = G.people, y = G.controller.yaw; const x = G.eye.x - Math.sin(y) * 5, z = G.eye.z - Math.cos(y) * 5; window.__b = P.dbgWalker(x, z, y); window.__b.until = 1e9; window.__b.mode = 'stand'; window.__b.stop && window.__b.stop(); return 1; })()

(() => { const p = window.__b, R = p.fig.rag; return JSON.stringify({ mode: p.mode, down: !!p.down, dead: !!p.dead, asleep: R ? R.asleep : null, minY: R ? +Math.min(...R.p.map(q => q.y)).toFixed(3) : null, d: +Math.hypot(p.pos.x - G.eye.x, p.pos.z - G.eye.z).toFixed(1), heat: G.police.heat, a: window.__a.mode }); })()

JSON.stringify({ a: [window.__a.mode, !!window.__a.down], b: [window.__b.mode, !!window.__b.down], heat: G.police.heat, say: [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent&&e.children.length===0&&e.innerText&&e.innerText.trim()).map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,40)).join(' | ') })
